_comment: miniverse workflow config — fill in YOUR_CLAUDE_LIT_WORKFLOW_PATH before first use
_setup: 1. Set claude_lit_dir to your local clone of claude_lit_workflow
_setup2: 2. Confirm uv_executable points to the uv binary (Windows: where uv; Mac/Linux: which uv)
_note_claude_lit_dir: Root directory of the claude_lit_workflow project. The slides / zettel / kb commands all run from this directory.
_note_python_executable: Full path to the Python executable used by import_wrapper.js to run import_zettel.py. Run 'where python' (Windows) or 'which python3' (Mac/Linux) to find it.
_note_uv_executable: Name or full path of the uv executable. If uv is on your PATH, 'uv' is sufficient; otherwise use a full path such as 'C:/Users/YourName/.cargo/bin/uv.exe'.
_note_pdf_source_in_vault: Folder inside the vault where PDFs are stored (relative to vault root). slides_wrapper will list PDFs from here.
_note_slides_output_subdir: Output directory for the slides command, mapped via symlink to claude_lit_workflow/output/ (relative to vault root). Generated slide Markdown files are stored here.
_note_zettel_output_subdir: Output subdirectory for the zettel command (relative to claude_lit_dir). import_wrapper.js reads pending zettel folders from here.
_note_twcc_models: Available models on your Ollama instance (local or remote). OLLAMA_URL is set in claude_lit_workflow/.env.
